newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 20.2775 percent.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 20.2775 percent.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Tuesday, July 8, was fixed at 20.2775 percent, or a fall of 51.75 basis points from 20.7950 percent, the rate for July 7, Banco de Mexico said on Monday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day, and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Tuesday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
